title: Sprites, Jets, and Glowing Balls: The Science of Lightning
speaker: SciShow
zh: 【SciShow】精靈、噴射流與發光球：閃電的科學（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Whether it’s up in the sky during a thunderstorm, or helping send a DeLorean back to the future,
cues.en: Whether it’s up in the sky during a thunderstorm, or helping send a DeLorean back to the future,
cues.zh: 無論是雷暴期間的天空，還是幫助將德羅寧送回未來，

cues.text: lightning is a beautiful, dangerous phenomenon.
cues.en: lightning is a beautiful, dangerous phenomenon.
cues.zh: 閃電是一種美麗而危險的現象。

cues.text: Most people picture lightning as a brilliant white strike that flashes between a cloud
cues.en: Most people picture lightning as a brilliant white strike that flashes between a cloud
cues.zh: 大多數人將閃電視為在雲層之間閃爍的明亮白色閃電

cues.text: and the ground.
cues.en: and the ground.
cues.zh: 和地面。

cues.text: But there’s also lightning within clouds, and between clouds.
cues.en: But there’s also lightning within clouds, and between clouds.
cues.zh: 但雲內和雲間也有閃電。

cues.text: Plus, there’s colored lightning, and even glowing ball lightning.
cues.en: Plus, there’s colored lightning, and even glowing ball lightning.
cues.zh: 另外，還有彩色閃電，甚至發光的球狀閃電。

cues.text: It’s all about a build-up of electric charge and the release of all that energy in a
cues.en: It’s all about a build-up of electric charge and the release of all that energy in a
cues.zh: 這都是關於電荷的積累和所有能量的釋放

cues.text: bright flash.
cues.en: bright flash.
cues.zh: 明亮的閃光。

cues.text: To have a lightning strike, first you need to separate positive and negative charges within a cloud.
cues.en: To have a lightning strike, first you need to separate positive and negative charges within a cloud.
cues.zh: 要發生雷擊，首先需要將雲中的正電荷和負電荷分開。

cues.text: Clouds are essentially a bunch of really small, dust-borne ice crystals and water molecules.
cues.en: Clouds are essentially a bunch of really small, dust-borne ice crystals and water molecules.
cues.zh: 雲本質上是一堆非常小的、塵埃攜帶的冰晶和水分子。

cues.text: During a storm, the air is moving around and making these particles collide.
cues.en: During a storm, the air is moving around and making these particles collide.
cues.zh: 在暴風雨期間，空氣會四處移動，使這些顆粒相互碰撞。

cues.text: So, one theory is that some negatively-charged electrons from the upward-moving water molecules
cues.en: So, one theory is that some negatively-charged electrons from the upward-moving water molecules
cues.zh: 因此，一種理論認為，向上移動的水分子中的一些帶負電的電子

cues.text: get transferred to the downward-moving, heavier particles.
cues.en: get transferred to the downward-moving, heavier particles.
cues.zh: 轉移到向下移動的較重的顆粒上。

cues.text: This makes the bottom of the storm cloud more negatively-charged, and the top of the storm
cues.en: This makes the bottom of the storm cloud more negatively-charged, and the top of the storm
cues.zh: 這使得風暴雲的底部帶有更多的負電荷，而風暴的頂部

cues.text: cloud more positively-charged.
cues.en: cloud more positively-charged.
cues.zh: 雲更帶正電。

cues.text: And remember: like charges repel each other.
cues.en: And remember: like charges repel each other.
cues.zh: 請記住：同種電荷會互相排斥。

cues.text: So, the electrons near the Earth’s surface are repelled away, and the ground underneath
cues.en: So, the electrons near the Earth’s surface are repelled away, and the ground underneath
cues.zh: 因此，靠近地球表面的電子被排斥，而下面的地面

cues.text: the cloud is left with an overall positive charge.
cues.en: the cloud is left with an overall positive charge.
cues.zh: 雲整體帶有正電荷。

cues.text: All this charge separation creates a strong electric field between the ground and the
cues.en: All this charge separation creates a strong electric field between the ground and the
cues.zh: 所有這些電荷分離在地面和地面之間產生了強電場

cues.text: cloud.
cues.en: cloud.
cues.zh: 雲。

cues.text: Basically, an electric field describes how much force, and in what direction a positive
cues.en: Basically, an electric field describes how much force, and in what direction a positive
cues.zh: 基本上，電場描述了法向力的大小和方向

cues.text: charge would go if it were in the field -- in this case, upward toward the cloud.
cues.en: charge would go if it were in the field -- in this case, upward toward the cloud.
cues.zh: 如果它在場中，電荷就會向上移動——在這種情況下，電荷會向上流向雲。

cues.text: And when the difference in charges builds up enough, the first stage of lightning begins.
cues.en: And when the difference in charges builds up enough, the first stage of lightning begins.
cues.zh: 當電荷差異夠大時，閃電的第一階段就開始了。

cues.text: Most of the time we see negative lightning.
cues.en: Most of the time we see negative lightning.
cues.zh: 大多數時候我們看到的是負面閃電。

cues.text: This is when the electric field grows strong enough that an invisible channel of negative charges, called a stepped leader, begins to branch toward the ground at about 50 meters
cues.en: This is when the electric field grows strong enough that an invisible channel of negative charges, called a stepped leader, begins to branch toward the ground at about 50 meters
cues.zh: 當電場變得足夠強時，一個看不見的負電荷通道（稱為階梯先導）開始在大約 50 公尺處向地面分支

cues.text: per microsecond.
cues.en: per microsecond.
cues.zh: 每微秒。

cues.text: Meanwhile, an upward-moving channel of positive charges called a streamer rises up.
cues.en: Meanwhile, an upward-moving channel of positive charges called a streamer rises up.
cues.zh: 同時，稱為流光的向上移動的正電荷通道上升。

cues.text: They meet with a huge, bright flash that travels up.
cues.en: They meet with a huge, bright flash that travels up.
cues.zh: 他們遇到了一道向上移動的巨大而明亮的閃光。

cues.text: Not to mention the heat -- over 25,000 degrees Celsius, which is about 5 times hotter than
cues.en: Not to mention the heat -- over 25,000 degrees Celsius, which is about 5 times hotter than
cues.zh: 更不用說溫度了——超過 25,000 攝氏度，大約是地球溫度的 5 倍。

cues.text: the surface of the Sun.
cues.en: the surface of the Sun.
cues.zh: 太陽表面。

cues.text: Because the negatively-charged electrons stream from the cloud down to the ground, it’s
cues.en: Because the negatively-charged electrons stream from the cloud down to the ground, it’s
cues.zh: 因為帶負電的電子從雲流到地面，

cues.text: called negative lightning.
cues.en: called negative lightning.
cues.zh: 稱為負閃電。

cues.text: There’s also the much-less-common positive lightning -- with a net transfer of positive
cues.en: There’s also the much-less-common positive lightning -- with a net transfer of positive
cues.zh: 還有不太常見的正閃電——具有正閃電的淨傳輸

cues.text: charge from the cloud to the ground instead.
cues.en: charge from the cloud to the ground instead.
cues.zh: 而是從雲端充電到地面。

cues.text: These strikes start at the top of a cloud, where positive charges hang out, so they need to travel through more air to reach the ground.
cues.en: These strikes start at the top of a cloud, where positive charges hang out, so they need to travel through more air to reach the ground.
cues.zh: 這些撞擊從雲層頂部開始，那裡有正電荷，因此它們需要穿過更多的空氣才能到達地面。

cues.text: So they need even more charge separation -- which means the strikes can be up to 10 times stronger
cues.en: So they need even more charge separation -- which means the strikes can be up to 10 times stronger
cues.zh: 因此，它們需要更多的電荷分離——這意味著衝擊力可以增強 10 倍

cues.text: than negative lightning.
cues.en: than negative lightning.
cues.zh: 比負閃電。

cues.text: In fact, these strikes can even break apart molecules in the atmosphere into ions, which
cues.en: In fact, these strikes can even break apart molecules in the atmosphere into ions, which
cues.zh: 事實上，這些撞擊甚至可以將大氣中的分子分解成離子，從而

cues.text: can collide with other molecules like hydrogen and oxygen, and cause photons of red light
cues.en: can collide with other molecules like hydrogen and oxygen, and cause photons of red light
cues.zh: 可與氫和氧等其他分子碰撞，並產生紅光光子

cues.text: to be released.
cues.en: to be released.
cues.zh: 被釋放。

cues.text: If this happens, we call them red sprites.
cues.en: If this happens, we call them red sprites.
cues.zh: 如果發生這種情況，我們稱它們為紅色精靈。

cues.text: They usually only last milliseconds, and can kinda look like giant jellyfish in the sky.
cues.en: They usually only last milliseconds, and can kinda look like giant jellyfish in the sky.
cues.zh: 它們通常只持續幾毫秒，看起來有點像天空中的巨型水母。

cues.text: And if that sounds cool -- there’s another type of lightning called a blue jet.
cues.en: And if that sounds cool -- there’s another type of lightning called a blue jet.
cues.zh: 如果這聽起來很酷的話——還有另一種型別的閃電，稱為藍色噴射。

cues.text: This lightning occurs when large amounts of positive charge stream upward, in order to neutralize the charge in the cloud.
cues.en: This lightning occurs when large amounts of positive charge stream upward, in order to neutralize the charge in the cloud.
cues.zh: 當大量正電荷向上流動以中和雲中的電荷時，就會發生這種閃電。

cues.text: The blue jets can get up to 40 kilometers high, but only last for fractions of a second.
cues.en: The blue jets can get up to 40 kilometers high, but only last for fractions of a second.
cues.zh: 藍色噴射流的高度可達 40 公里，但只能持續不到一秒。

cues.text: And scientists believe that their blue color comes from ionized nitrogen molecules.
cues.en: And scientists believe that their blue color comes from ionized nitrogen molecules.
cues.zh: 科學家認為它們的藍色來自電離氮分子。

cues.text: Even weirder is ball lightning -- a glowing grapefruit-sized ball of gas that lasts up
cues.en: Even weirder is ball lightning -- a glowing grapefruit-sized ball of gas that lasts up
cues.zh: 更奇怪的是球狀閃電——一種發光的葡萄柚大小的氣體球，可持續存在

cues.text: to 20 seconds.
cues.en: to 20 seconds.
cues.zh: 至 20 秒。

cues.text: But scientists aren’t quite sure what causes it.
cues.en: But scientists aren’t quite sure what causes it.
cues.zh: 但科學家不太確定是什麼原因造成的。

cues.text: One theory suggests that ball lightning is caused by the ions made by a lightning strike
cues.en: One theory suggests that ball lightning is caused by the ions made by a lightning strike
cues.zh: 一種理論認為球狀閃電是由雷擊產生的離子引起的

cues.text: near glass, like a window.
cues.en: near glass, like a window.
cues.zh: 靠近玻璃，如窗戶。

cues.text: The ions could pile up on one side of the glass and create an electric field, exciting
cues.en: The ions could pile up on one side of the glass and create an electric field, exciting
cues.zh: 離子可以堆積在玻璃的一側並產生電場，令人興奮

cues.text: air molecules on the other side, which would release photons and create a glow.
cues.en: air molecules on the other side, which would release photons and create a glow.
cues.zh: 另一側的空氣分子會釋放光子並產生光芒。

cues.text: Another theory suggests that elements in soil are to blame.
cues.en: Another theory suggests that elements in soil are to blame.
cues.zh: 另一種理論認為，土壤中的元素是罪魁禍首。

cues.text: In 2012, scientists in China recorded the first video of ball lightning.
cues.en: In 2012, scientists in China recorded the first video of ball lightning.
cues.zh: 2012年，中國科學家錄製了首個球狀閃電影片。

cues.text: They monitored the light it emitted, and found that it contained silicon, iron, and calcium,
cues.en: They monitored the light it emitted, and found that it contained silicon, iron, and calcium,
cues.zh: 他們監測它發出的光，發現它含有矽、鐵和鈣，

cues.text: which are all elements found in soil.
cues.en: which are all elements found in soil.
cues.zh: 這些都是土壤中發現的元素。

cues.text: So, a cloud-to-ground lightning strike might vaporize the soil’s silicate compounds,
cues.en: So, a cloud-to-ground lightning strike might vaporize the soil’s silicate compounds,
cues.zh: 因此，雲對地的雷擊可能會蒸發土壤中的矽酸鹽化合物，

cues.text: which react with the surrounding atmosphere to produce a ball of light.
cues.en: which react with the surrounding atmosphere to produce a ball of light.
cues.zh: 它與周圍的大氣反應，產生光球。

cues.text: So, the next time you’re watching a thunderstorm from the warm, dry safety of your home, remember
cues.en: So, the next time you’re watching a thunderstorm from the warm, dry safety of your home, remember
cues.zh: 因此，下次當您在溫暖、乾燥、安全的家中觀看雷暴時，請記住

cues.text: that all this lightning has a lot of physics behind it.
cues.en: that all this lightning has a lot of physics behind it.
cues.zh: 所有這些閃電背後都有許多物理原理。

cues.text: Beautiful, dangerous physics.
cues.en: Beautiful, dangerous physics.
cues.zh: 美麗而危險的物理學。

cues.en: Thanks for watching this episode of SciShow, brought to you by our patrons on Patreon.
